frames.board: B: origin at the first board corner, x along the board rows (to the image LEFT for a face-on upright camera, R_BC0 = diag(-1, 1, -1)), y down (gravity +y, vertical board), z = board normal toward the camera; metres
frames.camera: cam0: x right, y down, z optical axis; pitch = about x, yaw = about y, roll = about z
frames.quat: R_BC (camera -> board) as [w, x, y, z]; p_C = camera centre in B
frames.imu: gyro / accel in IMU axes: v_cam = R_CI v_imu, R_CI = T_CtoI[:3,:3]^T; *_cam fields are already rotated
frames.outline: 4 outer corners TL TR BR BL as seen by a face-on upright camera, then midpoints of TL-TR, TR-BR, BR-BL, BL-TL
